mapper.select: SELECT m.message_id as messageId, m.sender_id as senderId, CASE WHEN m.sender_id = 0 THEN '系统' ELSE COALESCE(u.username, '未知用户') END as senderName, u.avatar as senderAvatar, m.content, m.message_type as messageType, m.is_read as isRead, m.created_at as createdAt, m.image_url as imageUrl, CASE WHEN m.sender_id = 0 THEN true ELSE false END as isSystem FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u ON m.sender_id = u.user_id AND m.sender_id > 0 WHERE m.conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY m.created_at DESC

SELECT sender_info.sender_id as senderId, sender_info.sender_name as senderName, sender_info.sender_avatar as senderAvatar, sender_info.preview_content as previewContent, sender_info.last_time as lastTime, sender_info.is_system as isSystem, sender_info.message_type as messageType FROM ( -- 私信消息（非系统通知） SELECT m.sender_id, u.username as sender_name, u.avatar as sender_avatar, CASE WHEN m.message_type = 2 THEN '[图片]' ELSE LEFT(m.content, 50) END as preview_content, m.created_at as last_time, false as is_system, m.message_type FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u ON m.sender_id = u.user_id WHERE m.receiver_id = #{userId} AND m.message_type != 3
UNION ALL
-- 系统通知 SELECT 0 as sender_id, '系统通知' as sender_name, null as sender_avatar, LEFT(m.content, 50) as preview_content, m.created_at as last_time, true as is_system, m.message_type FROM message m WHERE m.receiver_id = #{userId} AND m.message_type = 3 ) sender_info ORDER BY sender_info.last_time DESC

SELECT m.message_id as messageId, m.sender_id as senderId, CASE WHEN m.sender_id = #{userId} THEN '我' ELSE u.username END as senderName, u.avatar as senderAvatar, m.content, m.message_type as messageType, m.is_read as isRead, m.created_at as createdAt, false as isSystem FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u ON m.sender_id = u.user_id WHERE ((m.sender_id = #{userId} AND m.receiver_id = #{chatUserId}) OR (m.sender_id = #{chatUserId} AND m.receiver_id = #{userId})) AND m.message_type != 3 ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
